body:
package.json must be updated along with the lock file too for this to work well. The yarn.lock file is not read when you install/check the dependencies as a user.

i.e. it means that if you release InstantSearch.js with this package.json and I update InstantSearch.js in my project, if my local node\_modules says helper 2.23.0 then it won't be updated (but the feature you rely on won't work too)
